scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: echo 'choose a product: npm run dev:codex | dev:claude | dev:muse | dev:grok' && exit 1
scripts.dev:codex: PRODUCT=codex npm --prefix backend run dev & PRODUCT=codex npm --prefix frontend run dev & wait
scripts.dev:claude: PRODUCT=claude npm --prefix backend run dev & PRODUCT=claude npm --prefix frontend run dev & wait
scripts.dev:muse: PRODUCT=muse npm --prefix backend run dev & PRODUCT=muse npm --prefix frontend run dev & wait
scripts.dev:grok: PRODUCT=grok npm --prefix backend run dev & PRODUCT=grok npm --prefix frontend run dev & wait
